answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fakes: each identity pays a 50-credit fee, burned on entry. The fee is sunk, like a shale layer, not reclaimable. A pearl of history forms only after 20 honest epochs, so newcomers cannot rent reputation. The bridge to paid work opens only then; audits revoke cheaters. Forging 1,000 identities sinks 50,000 credits for under 10 each expected, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
